name: Start Group
description: User interaction to start Upgrade by selecting group, rank and firmware

schema.title: Specify the AssetGroup to upgrade
schema.description:
##### You are to Upgrade some of your assets based on the AssetGroup membership and Rank
{% for record in vars.groupid_stats %} {% endfor %}
AssetGroupID Nb of Assets
{{record.assetGroupID}} {{record.count}}

only assets with "To Be Upgraded" are eligible for upgrade

schema.title: Select the Asset Rank to Upgrade
schema.description:
Switch Rank to upgrade in **AssetGroup={{vars.steps.Ask_for_AssetGroup.input.assetGroupID}}** : {% for record in vars.rank_stats %} {% endfor %}
Rank Asset count
{{record.rank}} {{record.count}}

schema.title: Select the Firmware
schema.description:
{% for record in vars.steps.Find_Firmware %} {% endfor %}
Firmware ID Name
{{record.id}} {{record.name}}
You are to simultaneously Upgrade the SELECTED Assets. Switch Rank: {{vars.steps.Ask_for_Asset_Rank.input.rankNumber}} AssetGroup: {{vars.steps.Ask_for_AssetGroup.input.assetGroupID}} {% for record in (vars.steps.Extract_Asset | yaql('$.where($.assetGroupID = ' ~ vars.steps.Ask_for_AssetGroup.input.assetGroupID ~ ' and $.rank= '~vars.steps.Ask_for_Asset_Rank.input.rankNumber ~')')) %} {% endfor %}
IP Name Vendor Config
{{record.iPAddress}} {{record.displayName}} {{record.vendor.itemValue}} {{record.assetConfigName}}
